| Voice | `speak` · `clone_voice` · `transcribe` | MiMo / MiniMax / Doubao + IndexTTS / GPT-"},{"id":"p26s9","text":"SoVITS / VoxCPM / TTS-WebUI; zero-registration inline & persisted cloning; speech-to-text via one Op"},{"id":"p26s10","text":"enAI-compatible protocol (local FunASR by default, no key needed) |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Every module has its own switch (on by default, except the STT sub-switch), but a switch alone is no"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"t enough: turning one off unregisters its tools completely, and an incomplete configuration never re"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"gisters the tool at all (0 token cost) while keeping your configuration."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Why a plugin instead of a Skill or a fixed script"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"| Approach | Typical pain | What this plugin does |"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"| Long Skill text (official-API recipes) | A big instruction dump every turn — expensive tokens | Co"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"nfig lives only in the settings page / `omni-vision.json`; tool schemas inject only when a module is"},{"id":"p30s3","text":" on |
| Fixed scripts (hand-written API calls) | Locked in a project folder; you must restate path a"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"nd usage each time | Tools register into the harness — the AI finds and reuses them automatically |
"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"| Changing config / switching models | Edit scripts or re-paste the Skill body | Change a field in S"},{"id":"p30s6","text":"ettings; it takes effect immediately |"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"In short: **less context, ready to use, config without code**."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## How It Works"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"The package is **dual-face**:"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"- **Host half** (`lib/index.js`) — a cordis plugin: registers tools on the global tools registry, lo"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"ads and persists `omni-vision.json` (see Configuration), and re-syncs registration on config changes"},{"id":"p34s3","text":" — including changes made by hand while it runs. The `/omni/*` web routes are registered only where "},{"id":"p34s4","text":"a `webServer` exists (web / desktop compositions); CLI and headless compositions get the tools witho"},{"id":"p34s5","text":"ut any HTTP surface.
- **Client half** (`lib/client.js`) — the browser module (loaded via the `dsh.c"},{"id":"p34s6","text":"lient` entry): registers the **Settings → Omni Workstation** section and its locale namespace (`sett"},{"id":"p34s7","text":"ings.omni-workstation`)."}],"truncated":true}
